events.title: 57 years since Woodstock
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place on Max Yasgur's dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or track from the legendary festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away at his Graceland home at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us 49 years ago today. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since Tupac Shakur's passing, his influence on music and culture remains as powerful as ever. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix died in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left us 56 years ago today. His sound is immortal.

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your top Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite track he's fronted?

events.title: Imagine album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message and an unforgettable album. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25 today! It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
